confirmed.problem: startIntro puts the new upload into the same intro record at once, with status 'processing'. readyIntro accepts only 'ready', so the old intro stops working the moment the analyst uploads a new one. Every new video of that analyst in that language then gets the blocking reason no_intro ('could not be processed. Record it again.'), although the old intro-{lang}.mp4 is still valid on disk (writeAtomic never replaced it). A failed recording should not replace the old one. rejected.reason: The code does behave as described (checks.ts:108-110 checks the language only on changed texts). But the behavior is a documented design choice: architecture.md 'Model output checks' says 'the language check on the texts that the model changed', and the prompt tells the model to keep company and product names as they are, so unchanged texts can be correct. The PRD sentence about rejecting the wrong language and asking again once is scoped to the company lines and the slide scripts ('Kimi-K3 writes the three company lines and the slide scripts...'). The proposed fix can also make results worse: translateContent keeps ALL originals when the check fails twice, so a partly translated answer would lose its good translations.

confirmed.prd: Video page captions (architecture: captions for WCAG 2.2 A 1.2.2)
confirmed.problem: cueTexts wraps each sentence greedily into lines of at most 42 characters and cuts after 2 lines. The last word of a sentence often becomes a cue of its own. The cue time is proportional to its character count, so these one-word cues show for only 0.25 s to 0.9 s. That is too short to read, so the captions lose words.
confirmed.evidence: GET /v/EhvzFFgSpvR16E1hmU5nMA/captions.v1.vtt: cue 5 '00:00:17.716 --> 00:00:18.192 finden.' (0.476 s), 'korrigieren.' 0.772 s, 'mir.' 0.251 s. GET /v/-IQftu1ZSaHMJ9RfDQTtaA/captions.v1.vtt: 'ostajan.' 0.547 s, 'ostettavaksi.' 0.891 s, 'Equity.' 0.464 s. timeline.ts:114-120 gives each cue `(end - start) * cue.length / total`.
confirmed.fix: In cueTexts, compute n = ceil(lines / 2) for each sentence. Split the words of the sentence into n cues with about the same number of characters, and wrap each cue into at most 2 lines of 42 characters (use n + 1 cues when a cue does not fit). In buildCaptions, give each cue a minimum of about 1 s. Take the extra time from the longer cues of the same segment, and stay inside the speech end. Add a shared test: for the fixture scripts in all six languages, no cue is shorter than 1 s and no cue is a single word when its sentence has more words.

rejected.reason: Refuted as a defect. The PRD sweep list (Hourly sweep, Session recordings, Delivery and privacy) deletes the media files, sessions, events and briefs. The architecture retention list adds form, meeting_email and scrape.markdown. Neither list includes deals.valuation. The claimed privacy effect (the exact profit can be computed from low / p25) adds no new exposure. pipedrive-write.ts:92-95 writes profitRange with pipedriveAmountText, which gives '1450000 EUR' for an exact profit (architecture decision 10), and it writes valuationRange from the same valuation. Pipedrive, which is a Mergero system, keeps both values after the expiry by design. So after the expiry, the SQLite copy of the valuation shows only what the Pipedrive deal fields keep anyway. No PRD sentence or architecture decision requires the purge of the valuation.

The main claim is refuted. After the overlay button unmounts, document.activeElement is BODY (checked in Chrome). But the sequential focus navigation starting point stays where the button was. In Chrome on /v/EhvzFFgSpvR16E1hmU5nMA?preview=1 (preview uses noopRecorder, so no POST went out), Enter on 'play-overlay' and then Tab moved the focus to the progress slider (role=slider, 'Videofortschritt') inside the player. The claim that WebKit starts again at the top of the page is false. The focus order is kept, so this is not a 2.4.3 failure, and 2.1.1 is met. The only effect is polish: the k and Space shortcuts on the player region do not work until the focus is back inside the player. This does not fail WCAG 2.2 A and no PRD sentence requires it.
